scope: Filesystem and decoded-pixel verification of the coordinator-operated real-browser fictional hero export; no OCR, benchmark, network requests or browser automation.

manual_mask.northstar_bbox_basis: Original fixture generator places Segoe UI 23 px NORTHSTAR at (28,12); bounding box independently computed from that font without regenerating any fixture.
manual_mask.approximation_note: The coordinator supplied approximate x=18; decoded output and the 151 x 43 px UI mask show actual x=19. The wider approximate rectangle includes one unmasked left column and does not meet the 99.5% test. This is disclosed; only the actual 151 x 43 mask and independently located NORTHSTAR region pass 120/120.
manual_mask.pixel_rule: At least 99.5% of cropped pixels have every channel <=16; exclusive right/bottom coordinates.

rescan.message: No supported text patterns detected in output; not a guarantee of privacy.

export_observations.provenance: Coordinator confirmed actual UI cancellation of a draft, deselect/reselect of email to verify dirty state, then re-export with the same final decisions and manual mask. The first downloaded report remains unchanged.
export_observations.caveat: Observed shared-workstation times for one fictional clip, not standardized throughput or speedup evidence.

limitations: One fictional demonstration; no automatic-recall or customer-footage claim.
Manual-mask pixel coverage is distinct from automatic detection accuracy.
Same-model rescan passed/0 findings is not independent privacy assurance.
Source integrity uses frozen demo and local imported-copy hashes; no new auth/API test is implied.
Responsive width checks are DOM measurements only at narrow sizes because coordinator screenshot capture failed after resize.
